examples.pinyin: wǒ hùi jǐnliàng xiǎng bànfǎ bāng nǐ de 。
examples.en: I will try my best to help you.

examples.zh: 你看书吧，我尽量不打扰你。
examples.pinyin: nǐ kàn shū ba，wǒ jǐnliàng bù dǎrǎo nǐ 。
examples.en: You read a book, I try not to disturb you.

examples.zh: 父母应该尽量多陪陪孩子。
examples.pinyin: fùmǔ yìnggāi jǐnliàng duō péi péi háizǐ 。
examples.en: Parents should accompany their children as much as possible.

examples.zh: 你是哥哥，要尽量照顾好妹妹。
examples.pinyin: nǐ shì gēgē，yào jǐnliàng zhàogù hǎo mèimèi 。
examples.en: You are an elder brother, you should take good care of your sister as much as possible.

lessons.title: Expressing difficulty with "hao (bu) rongyi"
lessons.pattern: Subj. + 好容易 / 好不容易 + 才 + Verb，[Result Sentence]

examples.zh: 我们好不容易才做完这个项目，结果合同取消了。
examples.pinyin: wǒmen hǎobùróngyì cái zuòwán zhè gè xiàngmù，jiéguǒ hétóng qǔxiāo le 。
examples.en: We finally finished the project and the contract was cancelled.

examples.zh: 我好不容易才到市中心，却发现没带手机，只好回去拿。
examples.pinyin: wǒ hǎobùróngyì cái dào shìzhōngxīn， què fāxiàn méi dài shǒujī，zhǐhǎo húiqù ná 。
examples.en: I finally got to the city center, but found that I didn't bring my cell phone with me, so I had to go back and get it.

examples.zh: 金融危机之后他好不容易才找到工作，现在又辞职了。
examples.pinyin: jīnróng wēijī zhīhòu tā hǎobùróngyì cái zhǎodào gōngzuò，xiànzài yòu cízhí le 。
examples.en: After the financial crisis, he finally found a job, and now he resigned.

examples.zh: 我好不容易才打通了银行的服务热线。
examples.pinyin: wǒ hǎobùróngyì cái dǎtōng le yínxíng de fúwù rèxiàn 。
examples.en: I finally got through the bank's service hotline.

examples.zh: 互相帮助
examples.pinyin: hùxiāng bāngzhù
examples.en: Help each other

examples.zh: 互相了解
examples.pinyin: hùxiāng lejiě
examples.en: know each other

examples.zh: 互相伤害
examples.pinyin: hùxiāng shānghài
examples.en: Hurt each other

examples.zh: 互相尊重
examples.pinyin: hùxiāng zūnzhòng
examples.en: mutual respect

examples.zh: 大家有话尽管说。
examples.pinyin: dàjiā yǒu huà jǐnguǎn shuō 。
examples.en: Everyone has something to say.

examples.zh: 有什么问题尽管问。
examples.pinyin: yǒu shíyāo wèntí jǐnguǎn wèn 。
examples.en: Just ask any questions.

examples.zh: 有什么事尽管找我。
examples.pinyin: yǒu shíyāo shì jǐnguǎn zhǎo wǒ 。
examples.en: Please come to me for anything.

examples.zh: 这些饮料是免费的，尽管喝。
examples.pinyin: zhèxiē yǐnliào shì miǎnfèi de ， jǐnguǎn hē 。
examples.en: These drinks are free, despite drinking.

examples.zh: 我们都是打工的，不得不服从公司的安排。
examples.pinyin: wǒmen dū shì dǎgōngde ， bùdébù fúcóng gōngsī de ānpái 。
examples.en: We are all part-time workers and have to obey the company's arrangements.

examples.zh: 你真的太厉害了，我不得不承认。
examples.pinyin: nǐ zhēnde tài lìhài le ， wǒ bùdébù chéngrèn 。
examples.en: You are really amazing, I have to admit.

examples.zh: 电梯又坏了，我们不得不爬楼梯。
examples.pinyin: diàntī yòu huàile ， wǒmen bùdébù pálóutī 。
examples.en: The elevator broke down again and we had to climb the stairs.

examples.zh: 你真会说话，这一点我们不得不佩服。
examples.pinyin: nǐ zhēn hùi shuōhuà ，zhèyīdiǎn wǒmen bùdébù pèifú 。
examples.en: You really talk, we have to admire this.

examples.zh: 家里什么都没有，干脆出去吃吧。
examples.pinyin: jiālǐshíyāodūméiyǒu，gāncùichūqùchība 。
examples.en: There is nothing at home, just go out and eat.

examples.zh: 既然学不好，干脆别学了。
examples.pinyin: jìránxuébùhǎo，gāncùibiéxuéle 。
examples.en: Since you haven't learned well, just stop learning.

examples.zh: 这台破电脑又坏了，干脆别修了，买台新的吧。
examples.pinyin: zhètáipòdiànnǎoyòuhuàile，gāncùibiéxīule，mǎitáixīndeba 。
examples.en: This broken computer is broken again. Don't fix it, just buy a new one.

examples.zh: 苹果很贵，我干脆没买，只买了点香蕉。
examples.pinyin: píngguǒhěngùi，wǒgāncùiméimǎi，zhǐmǎilediǎnxiāngjiāo 。
examples.en: Apples are very expensive. I didn't buy them at all. I just bought some bananas.

lessons.title: Expressing "nearly" with "jihu"
lessons.pattern: 几乎 + Subj. + 都 + Verb / Adj.

examples.zh: 几乎每个人都有手机。
examples.pinyin: jīhū měi gè rén dū yǒu shǒujī 。
examples.en: Almost everyone has a mobile phone.

examples.zh: 在我们公司，几乎每个人都会说英文。
examples.pinyin: zài wǒmen gōngsī，jīhū měi gè rén dū hùi shuō yīngwén 。
examples.en: In our company, almost everyone speaks English.

examples.zh: 在中国，几乎所有老外都会说“你好”。
examples.pinyin: zài zhōngguó，jīhū suǒyǒu lǎowài dū hùi shuō “nǐhǎo” 。
examples.en: In China, almost all foreigners will say "hello".

examples.zh: 几乎所有人都相信他。
examples.pinyin: jīhū suǒyǒu rén dū xiāngxìn tā 。
examples.en: Almost everyone believed him.

lessons.title: Expressing "never again" with "zai ye bu"
lessons.pattern: Subj. + 再也 + 不 + Verb-Obj. + 了
lessons.category: Referring to the future, Expressing time and date

examples.zh: 我再也不想看到你了！
examples.pinyin: wǒ zàiyěbù xiǎng kàndào nǐ le ！
examples.en: I don't want to see you anymore!

examples.zh: 我再也不想跟你说话了。
examples.pinyin: wǒ zàiyěbù xiǎng gēn nǐ shuōhuà le 。
examples.en: I don't want to talk to you anymore.

examples.zh: 我们再也不会相信你了！
examples.pinyin: wǒmen zàiyěbù hùi xiāngxìn nǐ le ！
examples.en: We will never trust you again!

examples.zh: 医生说她再也不能跳舞了。
examples.pinyin: yìshēng shuō tāzàiyěbù néng tiàowǔ le 。
examples.en: The doctor said she could no longer dance.

lessons.title: Expressing "once" with "cengjing"
lessons.pattern: Subj. + 曾经 + Verb + 过 (+ Obj.)
lessons.category: Referring to the past, Expressing time and date

examples.zh: 我们曾经一起去过。
examples.pinyin: wǒmen céngjīng yīqǐ qù guò 。
examples.en: We have been there together.

examples.zh: 他说他曾经做过很多傻事。
examples.pinyin: tā shuō tā céngjīng zuò guò hěnduō shǎshì 。
examples.en: He said he had done many stupid things.

examples.zh: 我曾经喜欢过你。
examples.pinyin: wǒ céngjīng xǐhuān guò nǐ 。
examples.en: I used to like you.

examples.zh: 她曾经想当演员，后来成了全职太太。
examples.pinyin: tā céngjīng xiǎng dāng yǎnyuán ，hòulái chéng le quánzhítàitài 。
examples.en: She once wanted to be an actor, but later became a full-time wife.

examples.zh: 老师再三强调这次考试对我们很重要。
examples.pinyin: lǎoshī zàisān qiángdiào zhè cì kǎoshì dùi wǒmen hěn zhòngyào 。
examples.en: The teacher repeatedly emphasized that this exam is very important to us.

examples.zh: 中国政府再三警告美国不要干涉中国的内政。
examples.pinyin: zhōngguó zhèngfǔ zàisān jǐnggào měiguó bùyào gānshè zhōngguó de nèizhèng 。
examples.en: The Chinese government has repeatedly warned the United States not to interfere in China ’s internal affairs.

examples.zh: 她再三犹豫之后，选择了放弃比赛。
examples.pinyin: tā zàisān yóuyù zhīhòu，xuǎnzé le fàngqì bǐsài 。
examples.en: After hesitating again and again, she chose to give up the game.

examples.zh: 我们再三考虑过后，决定满足你的这个要求。
examples.pinyin: wǒmen zàisān kǎolv̀ guòhòu，juédìng mǎnzú nǐ de zhè gè yàoqíu 。
examples.en: After careful consideration, we decided to meet your request.

examples.zh: 他简直是个魔鬼！
examples.pinyin: tā jiǎnzhí shì gè mógǔi ！
examples.en: He is simply a devil!

examples.zh: 他唱歌简直难听死了！
examples.pinyin: tā chànggē jiǎnzhí nántīng sǐle ！
examples.en: He sings so ugly!

examples.zh: 你男朋友简直太帅了！
examples.pinyin: nǐ nán péngyǒu jiǎnzhí tài shuài le ！
examples.en: Your boyfriend is so handsome!

examples.zh: 我简直不明白他为什么这么傻！
examples.pinyin: wǒ jiǎnzhí bù míngbái tā wèishíyāo zhèyāo shǎ ！
examples.en: I can't understand why he is so stupid!

lessons.title: Expressing "since the beginning" with "yixiang"
lessons.pattern: Subj. + 一向 + Habit / Attitude / etc.
lessons.category: Referring to habitual actions, Referring to the past, Expressing frequency, Expressing time and date

examples.zh: 他一向是个好学生，怎么可能会作弊呢？
examples.pinyin: tā yīxiàng shì gè hǎo xuéshēng，zěnyāo kěnéng hùi zuòbì ní ？
examples.en: He has always been a good student, how could he cheat?

examples.zh: 中国人一向把红色视为吉祥喜庆的颜色。
examples.pinyin: zhōngguórén yīxiàng bǎ hóngsè shìwèi jíxiáng xǐqìng de yánsè 。
examples.en: The Chinese have always regarded red as an auspicious color.

examples.zh: 云南的雨季一向来得很突然。
examples.pinyin: yúnnán de yǔjì yīxiàng lái dé hěn tūrán 。
examples.en: The rainy season in Yunnan has always been very sudden.

examples.zh: 他的态度一向很认真。
examples.pinyin: tā de tàidù yīxiàng hěn rènzhēn 。
examples.en: His attitude has always been serious.

examples.zh: 白花了一百块钱，这件衣服不能穿。
examples.pinyin: bái huā le yī bǎi kuài qián，zhè jiàn yīfú bù néng chuān 。
examples.en: Bai spent a hundred dollars, and this dress cannot be worn.

examples.zh: 他不回来吃饭了？
examples.pinyin: tā bù húilái chīfàn le ？
examples.en: He is not coming back for dinner?

examples.zh: 你一句汉语都不会说，白学了这么长时间。
examples.pinyin: nǐ yī jù hànyǔ dū bù hùi shuō，bái xué le zhèyāo cháng shíjiān 。
examples.en: You can't speak a single sentence of Chinese. Bai has studied for so long.

examples.zh: 我去的时候他不在家，所以我白跑了一趟。
examples.pinyin: wǒ qù de shíhòu tā bù zài jiā， suǒyǐ wǒ bái pǎo le yī tàng 。
examples.en: He was not at home when I went, so I ran in vain.

examples.zh: 你去买早饭的时候顺便帮我带杯咖啡吧。
examples.pinyin: nǐ qù mǎi zǎofàn de shíhòu shùnbiàn bāng wǒ dài bēi kāfēi ba 。
examples.en: Help me bring a cup of coffee when you go to buy breakfast.

examples.zh: 你去超市能不能顺便帮我买一瓶牛奶？
examples.pinyin: nǐ qù chāoshì néng bù néng shùnbiàn bāng wǒ mǎi yī píng níunǎi ？
examples.en: Can you help me buy a bottle of milk by the way?

examples.zh: 老板去见客户，顺便吃了午饭。
examples.pinyin: lǎobǎn qù jiàn kèhù，shùnbiàn chī le wǔfàn 。
examples.en: The boss went to meet the customer and had lunch by the way.

examples.zh: 我下周去北京出差，顺便去看一个朋友。
examples.pinyin: wǒ xiàzhōu qù běijīng chūchà，shùnbiàn qù kàn yī gè péngyǒu 。
examples.en: I will go to Beijing for a business trip next week and stop by to see a friend.

lessons.title: The opposite of "chabuduo" is "cha hen duo"

examples.zh: 中西方的文化差很多。
examples.pinyin: zhōng xīfāng de wénhuà chà hěn duō 。
examples.en: Chinese and Western cultures are much different.

examples.zh: 这两个词的意思差不多，但是用法差很多。
examples.pinyin: zhè liǎng gè cí de yìsī chàbùduō，dànshì yòngfǎ chà hěn duō 。
examples.en: The meaning of these two words is similar, but their usage is much different.

examples.zh: 她和她老公的年龄差很多。
examples.pinyin: tā hé tā lǎogōng de niánlíng chà hěn duō 。
examples.en: She and her husband are much different in age.

examples.zh: 公司今年的收入跟去年差很多。
examples.pinyin: gōngsī jīnnián de shōurù gēn qùnián chà hěn duō 。
examples.en: The company's revenue this year is much worse than last year.

lessons.title: Listing things with "a"
lessons.pattern: A 啊， B 啊， C 啊⋯⋯

examples.zh: 我们什么零食都有，花生啊，瓜子啊，薯片啊，你随便吃吧。
examples.pinyin: wǒmen shíyāo língshí dū yǒu，huāshēng a，guāzǐ a，shǔpiàn a，nǐ súibiàn chī ba 。
examples.en: We have all kinds of snacks, peanuts, melon seeds, potato chips, you can eat whatever you want.

examples.zh: 椅子啊，桌子啊，电脑啊什么的都买好了，现在办公室只差招员工了！
examples.pinyin: yǐzǐ a，zhuōzǐ a，diànnǎo a shíyāode dū mǎi hǎo le，xiànzài bàngōngshì zhǐ chà zhāo yuángōng le！
examples.en: Chairs, desks, computers and everything have been bought, and now the office only has to hire staff!

examples.zh: 《发展汉语》啊，《实用汉语课本》啊，我都学过，没用！
examples.pinyin: 《fāzhǎn hànyǔ》 a， 《shíyòng hànyǔ kèběn》 a，wǒ dū xué guò，méi yòng！
examples.en: "Development Chinese", "Practical Chinese Textbook", I have learned it, it is useless!

examples.zh: 政府每年都会维护和修理这些建筑。
examples.pinyin: zhèngfǔ měinián dū hùi wéihù hé xīulǐ zhèxiē jiànzhú 。
examples.en: The government maintains and repairs these buildings every year.

examples.zh: 我们需要进一步地了解和交流。
examples.pinyin: wǒmen xūyào jìnyībù dì lejiě hé jiāolíu 。
examples.en: We need to understand and communicate further.

examples.zh: 他十八岁的时候就管理和运营着一家公司。
examples.pinyin: tā shíbāsùi de shíhòu jìu guǎnlǐ hé yùnyíng zháo yī jiā gōngsī 。
examples.en: He managed and operated a company when he was eighteen.

examples.zh: 这种材料可以无限地回收和利用。
examples.pinyin: zhè zhǒng cáiliào kěyǐ wúxiàn dì húishōu hé lìyòng 。
examples.en: This material can be recycled and used indefinitely.

lessons.title: Expressing "how about" with "yaobu"
lessons.pattern: 要不 + Suggestion ，Reason / Situation :: / :: Reason / Situation ，要不 + Suggestion
lessons.category: Indicating cause and effect, Giving alternatives

examples.zh: 大家都有点累了，要不休息一会儿吧。
examples.pinyin: dàjiā dū yǒudiǎn lèi le，yàobù xīuxī yīhùiér ba 。
examples.en: Everyone is a little tired, or have a rest.

examples.zh: 要不我们一起去吧，一个人去没意思。
examples.pinyin: yàobù wǒmen yīqǐ qù ba ，yīgèrén qù méi yìsī 。
examples.en: Or should we go together, it ’s boring to go alone.

examples.zh: 这个星期我比较忙，要不下个星期见？
examples.pinyin: zhègè xīngqī wǒ bǐjiào máng ，yàobù xià gè xīngqī jiàn ？
examples.en: I ’m busy this week. See you next week?

examples.zh: 要不我们换个地方吧，这里太吵了。
examples.pinyin: yàobù wǒmen huàn gè dìfāng ba ，zhèlǐ tài chǎo le 。
examples.en: Or should we change places, it's too noisy here.

examples.zh: 你们这样做其实是彼此伤害。
examples.pinyin: nǐmen zhèyáng zuò qíshí shì bǐcǐ shānghài 。
examples.en: You actually hurt each other by doing so.

examples.zh: 结婚以前夫妻应该多花时间彼此了解。
examples.pinyin: jiéhūn yǐqián fūqī yìnggāi duō huā shíjiān bǐcǐ lejiě 。
examples.en: Before marriage, couples should spend more time understanding each other.

examples.zh: 我们是一个部门的，工作上要彼此配合。
examples.pinyin: wǒmen shì yī gè bùmén de，gōngzuò shàng yào bǐcǐ pèihé 。
examples.en: We are a department, and we must cooperate with each other in our work.

examples.zh: 如果你们不能彼此信任，这次合作不太可能成功。
examples.pinyin: rúguǒ nǐmen bù néng bǐcǐ xìnrèn，zhè cì hézuò bù tài kěnéng chénggōng 。
examples.en: If you cannot trust each other, this cooperation is unlikely to succeed.

lessons.title: Expressing "among" with "dangzhong"
lessons.pattern: Group + 当中 :: / :: Process + 当中

examples.zh: 你是我所有朋友当中最聪明的一个。
examples.pinyin: nǐ shì wǒ suǒyǒu péngyǒu dāngzhōng zùi cōngmíng de yī gè 。
examples.en: You are the smartest of all my friends.

examples.zh: 在这一百个选手当中我表现得最出色。
examples.pinyin: zài zhè yībǎi gè xuǎnshǒu dāngzhōng wǒ biǎoxiàn dé zùi chūsè 。
examples.en: Among the 100 players, I performed the best.

examples.zh: 这个工程还在计划当中。
examples.pinyin: zhè gè gōngchéng huánzài jìhuá dāngzhōng 。
examples.en: This project is still being planned.

lessons.title: Expressing "each other" with "bici"
lessons.pattern: Verb + 彼此 :: / :: 彼此 + Verb

examples.zh: 我们只见过一次，彼此不是很了解。
examples.pinyin: wǒmen zhǐ jiàn guò yī cì ，bǐcǐ bùshì hěn lejiě 。
examples.en: We have only seen it once and we don't know each other very well.

examples.zh: 我们是一个团队，彼此应该多沟通。
examples.pinyin: wǒmen shì yīgè tuándùi ，bǐcǐ yìnggāi duō gōutōng 。
examples.en: We are a team and should communicate more with each other.

examples.zh: 我很尊重我的对手，我希望彼此都能有好的表现。
examples.pinyin: wǒ hěn zūnzhòng wǒ de dùishǒu ，wǒ xīwàng bǐcǐ dū néng yǒu hǎo de biǎoxiàn 。
examples.en: I respect my opponents very much, and I hope each other can perform well.

examples.zh: 我们是一家人，必须好好照顾彼此。
examples.pinyin: wǒmen shì yījiārén ，bìxū hǎohǎo zhàogù bǐcǐ 。
examples.en: We are a family and we must take good care of each other.

lessons.title: Expressing "ever since" with "yilai"
lessons.category: Referring to the past, Sequencing events in time

examples.zh: 今年八月以来，这里一直没下过雨。
examples.pinyin: jīnnián bāyuè yǐlái ，zhèlǐ yīzhí méi xià guò yǔ 。
examples.en: It has not rained here since August this year.

examples.zh: 结婚以来，我们没吵过架。
examples.pinyin: jiéhūn yǐlái ，wǒmen méi chǎo guò jià 。
examples.en: We haven't quarreled since we got married.

examples.zh: 上大学以来，他变了很多。
examples.pinyin: shàng dàxué yǐlái ，tā biàn le hěn duō 。
examples.en: He has changed a lot since he went to college.

examples.zh: 从他爸爸去世以来，他就没有回过家。
examples.pinyin: cóng tā bàbà qùshì yǐlái ，tā jìu méiyǒu húi guò jiā 。
examples.en: Since his father's death, he has not returned home.

lessons.title: Name-calling with "zhege"
lessons.pattern: Subj. + 这个 /  这种 / 这类 + [Category]
lessons.category: Describing people, Describing things, Emphasizing, Differentiating

examples.zh: 你这个坏蛋，就没做过一件好事。
examples.pinyin: nǐ zhègè huàidàn，jìu méi zuò guò yī jiàn hǎo shì 。
examples.en: You bad guy, never did a good thing.

examples.zh: 他这个马屁精，又去拍老板的马屁了。
examples.pinyin: tā zhègè mǎpìjīng，yòu qù pāi lǎobǎn de mǎpì le 。
examples.en: He asshole, went to pat the boss's ass.

examples.zh: 上海这个城市，夏天太热，冬天太冷。
examples.pinyin: shànghǎi zhègè chéngshì，xiàtiān tài rè，dōngtiān tài lěng 。
examples.en: The city of Shanghai is too hot in summer and too cold in winter.

examples.zh: 猕猴桃这种水果，营养价值最高。
examples.pinyin: míhóutáo zhèzhǒng shǔiguǒ，yíngyǎng jiàzhí zùi gāo 。
examples.en: Kiwi fruit is the fruit with the highest nutritional value.

lessons.title: Advanced "le" after an object
lessons.pattern: Subj. + Verb + 了 + Obj. :: / :: Subj. + Verb + Obj. + 了
lessons.category: Describing actions, Referring to the past, Expressing completion

examples.zh: 我上了课。
examples.pinyin: wǒ shàng le kè 。
examples.en: I took the class.

examples.zh: 老师问了问题。
examples.pinyin: lǎoshī wèn le wèntí 。
examples.en: The teacher asked a question.

examples.zh: 他买了一辆车。
examples.pinyin: tā mǎi le yīliàng chē 。
examples.en: He bought a car.

examples.zh: 妈妈做了很多菜。
examples.pinyin: māmā zuò le hěnduō cài 。
examples.en: Mom made many dishes.

lessons.title: Advanced "le" with complements
lessons.pattern: Subj. + Verb + Complement + 了 :: / :: Subj. + Verb + 了 + Complement
lessons.category: Describing actions, Referring to the past, Expressing completion

examples.zh: 买到了。
examples.pinyin: mǎi dào le 。
examples.en: bought.

examples.zh: 做起来了。
examples.pinyin: zuò qǐlái le 。
examples.en: Do it.

examples.zh: 吃完了。
examples.pinyin: chī wán le 。
examples.en: Finished.

examples.zh: 穿好了。
examples.pinyin: chuān hǎo le 。
examples.en: Wear it.

examples.zh: 大熊猫嘛，大家都喜欢。
examples.pinyin: dà xióngmāoma ，dàjiā dū xǐhuān 。
examples.en: Everyone likes giant pandas.

examples.zh: 名牌嘛，一定不便宜。
examples.pinyin: míngpái ma ，yīdìng bù biànyí 。
examples.en: Well-known brand, certainly not cheap.

examples.zh: 第一次嘛，以后就会了。
examples.pinyin: dì yī cì ma ，yǐhòu jìu hùi le 。
examples.en: The first time, it will be later.

examples.zh: 孩子嘛，不懂这些很正常。
examples.pinyin: háizǐ ma ，bù dǒng zhèxiē hěn zhèngcháng 。
examples.en: Well, it ’s normal not to understand these things.

lessons.title: Softening the tone of questions with "ne"
lessons.pattern: Option 1 + 呢 + 还是 + Option 2 + 呢？

examples.zh: 我去缅甸呢，还是泰国呢？我得想一想！
examples.pinyin: wǒ qù miǎndiàn ní，huánshì tàiguóní ？wǒ dé xiǎng yī xiǎng！
examples.en: Should I go to Myanmar or Thailand? I have to think about it!

examples.zh: 咱们打游戏呢，还是泡吧呢，我都可以！
examples.pinyin: zánmen dǎ yóuxì ní ，huánshì pàoba ní ，wǒ dū kěyǐ！
examples.en: Let's play the game, let's go clubbing.

examples.zh: 这是谁的笔呢?
examples.pinyin: zhè shì shúi de bǐní?
examples.en: Whose pen is this?

examples.zh: 他去哪儿了呢？
examples.pinyin: tā qù nǎér le ní ？
examples.en: Where did he go?

lessons.title: Taiwanese "you"
lessons.category: Referring to the past, Referring to past experiences

examples.zh: 我们有听懂你的话。
examples.pinyin: wǒmen yǒu tīngdǒng nǐ de huà 。
examples.en: We understand you.

examples.zh: 我们都有听到宝宝哭。
examples.pinyin: wǒmen dū yǒu tīngdào bǎobǎo kū 。
examples.en: We all heard the baby cry.

examples.zh: 我有看到他们吵架。
examples.pinyin: wǒ yǒu kàndào tāmen chǎojià 。
examples.en: I have seen them quarreling.

examples.zh: 他有学，而且很喜欢。
examples.pinyin: tā yǒu xué ，érqiě hěn xǐhuān 。
examples.en: He is academic and likes it very much.

lessons.title: Defining scope
lessons.pattern: 级别 / 次序 / 数目 + 以上 / 以下

examples.zh: 我老家空气还不错，PM2.5一般在五十以下。
examples.pinyin: wǒ lǎojiā kōngqì huán bùcuò，PM2.5 yībān zài wǔshí yǐxià 。
examples.en: The air in my hometown is not bad, PM2.5 is generally below fifty.

examples.zh: 我们需要有两年以上工作经验的人。
examples.pinyin: wǒmen xūyào yǒu liǎng nián yǐshàng gōngzuò jīngyàn de rén 。
examples.en: We need people with more than two years of work experience.

examples.zh: 十岁以下的孩子不用买票。
examples.pinyin: shí sùi yǐxià de háizǐ bùyòng mǎi piào 。
examples.en: Children under ten years old do not need to buy tickets.

examples.zh: 我们出差都住三星级以上的酒店。
examples.pinyin: wǒmen chūchà dū zhù sān xīngjí yǐshàng de jǐudiàn 。
examples.en: We are staying in hotels with more than three stars on business trips.

lessons.title: Expressing "ever since" with "zicong"
lessons.pattern: 自 / 从 / 自从 + Time / Event + 以来
lessons.category: Referring to the past, Sequencing events in time

examples.zh: 从他爸爸去世以来，他一直没回过家。
examples.pinyin: cóng tā bàbà qùshì yǐlái ，tā yīzhí méi húi guò jiā 。
examples.en: Since his father's death, he has never returned home.

examples.zh: 从毕业以来，她一直在教汉语。
examples.pinyin: cóng bìyè yǐlái，tā yīzhí zài jiào hànyǔ 。
examples.en: Since graduating, she has been teaching Chinese.

examples.zh: 自改革开放以来，中国社会发生了巨大的变化。
examples.pinyin: zì gǎigé kāifàng yǐlái ，zhōngguó shèhùi fāshēng le jùdà de biànhuà 。
examples.en: Since the reform and opening up, great changes have taken place in Chinese society.

examples.zh: 自从妹妹出生以来，妈妈就更忙了。
examples.pinyin: zìcóng mèimèi chūshēng yǐlái ，māmā jìu gèng máng le 。
examples.en: Since my sister was born, my mother has been busier.

examples.zh: 对一个民族而言，团结可以战胜一切。
examples.pinyin: dùi yīgè mínzú éryán ，tuánjié kěyǐ zhànshèng yīqiē 。
examples.en: For a nation, unity can overcome everything.

examples.zh: 对消费者而言，促销活动很有吸引力。
examples.pinyin: dùi xiāofèizhě éryán ，cùxiāo huódòng hěn yǒu xīyǐnlì 。
examples.en: For consumers, promotional activities are very attractive.

examples.zh: 对80后而言，网恋很正常。
examples.pinyin: dùi 80hòu éryán ，wǎngliàn hěn zhèngcháng 。
examples.en: For the post-80s, online dating is normal.

examples.zh: 我们都为你高兴。
examples.pinyin: wǒmen dū wèi nǐ gāoxīng 。
examples.en: We are all happy for you.

examples.zh: 谁为我考虑过？
examples.pinyin: shúi wèi wǒ kǎolv̀ guò ？
examples.en: Who considered it for me?

examples.zh: 你们可以来为我们加油。
examples.pinyin: nǐmen kěyǐ lái wèi wǒmen jiāyóu 。
examples.en: You can come and cheer for us.

examples.zh: 她是为美国政府工作的。
examples.pinyin: tā shì wèi měiguó zhèngfǔ gōngzuò de 。
examples.en: She works for the US government.

examples.zh: 包括他的母语在内，他会说四种语言。
examples.pinyin: bāokuò tā de mǔyǔ zàinèi ，tā hùi shuō sì zhǒng yǔyán 。
examples.en: Including his mother tongue, he speaks four languages.

examples.zh: 水电费在内，我每个月的房租三千五。
examples.pinyin: shǔidiànfèi zàinèi ，wǒ měi gè yuè de fángzū sānqiān wǔ 。
examples.en: Including water and electricity bills, my monthly rent is 35,000.

examples.zh: 这次袭击造成了三人死亡，包括两名警察在内。
examples.pinyin: zhè cì xíjí zàochéng le sānrén sǐwáng ，bāokuò liǎng míng jǐngchá zàinèi 。
examples.en: The attack killed three people, including two police officers.

examples.zh: 小米会在下个月发布包括小米电视在内的几个新产品。
examples.pinyin: xiǎomǐ hùi zài xiàgèyuè fābù bāokuò xiǎomǐ diànshì zàinèi de jī gè xīnchǎnpǐn 。
examples.en: Xiaomi will release several new products including Xiaomi TV next month.

examples.zh: 凭护照，外国人可以买火车票。
examples.pinyin: píng hùzhào， wàiguó rén kěyǐ mǎi huǒchē piào 。
examples.en: With a passport, foreigners can buy train tickets.

examples.zh: 他凭自己的努力学了三千多个汉字。
examples.pinyin: tā píng zìjǐ de nǔlì xué le sānqiān duō gè hànzì 。
examples.en: He learned more than three thousand Chinese characters with his own efforts.

examples.zh: 我们凭学生证在电影院享受折扣优待。
examples.pinyin: wǒmen píng xuéshēngzhèng zài diànyǐngyuàn xiǎngshòu zhékòu yōudài 。
examples.en: We use the student ID to enjoy discounts at the cinema.

examples.zh: 怪不得那个孩子的数学不好，他只凭计算器算。
examples.pinyin: guàibùdé nà gè háizǐ de shùxué bù hǎo，tā zhǐ píng jìsuànqì suàn 。
examples.en: No wonder that child's math is not good, he only counts on a calculator.

lessons.title: Expressing passive voice with "gei"
lessons.pattern: Receiver + 给 + The Doer + Verb Phrase

examples.zh: 我给他骗了。
examples.pinyin: wǒ gěi tā piàn le 。
examples.en: I lied to him.

examples.zh: 这么好的机会给你浪费了。
examples.pinyin: zhèyāo hǎo de jīhùi gěi nǐ làngfèi le 。
examples.en: Such a good opportunity is wasted for you.

examples.zh: 菜都给你们吃完了吗？
examples.pinyin: cài dū gěi nǐmen chī wánle ma ？
examples.en: Have you finished the dishes?

examples.zh: 孩子都给你宠坏了。
examples.pinyin: háizǐ dū gěi nǐ chǒng huài le 。
examples.en: The kids are spoiled for you.

examples.zh: 我已经尽力了，至于结果只能看运气了。
examples.pinyin: wǒ yǐjīng jǐnlì le，zhìyú jiéguǒ zhǐ néng kàn yùnqì le 。
examples.en: I have tried my best, as for the result, I can only look at luck.

examples.zh: 她跟我说明天回来，至于具体的时间，我就不知道了。
examples.pinyin: tā gēn wǒ shuō míngtiān húilái，zhìyú jùtǐ de shíjiān，wǒ jìu bù zhīdào le 。
examples.en: She explained to me that when the day came back, as for the specific time, I would not know.

examples.zh: 律师只能为他的客户辩护，至于最后的判决，那就取决于法官了。
examples.pinyin: lv̀shī zhǐnéng wèitā de kèhù biànhù，zhìyú zùihòu de pànjué，nà jìu qǔjuéyú fǎguān le 。
examples.en: The lawyer can only defend his client. As for the final judgment, it depends on the judge.

lessons.title: Limiting scope with "jiu"
lessons.pattern: Subj. + 就 + 活动的对象或者范围 + Verb + Obj.

examples.zh: 大家就中国互联网的发展发表了各自的看法。
examples.pinyin: dàjiā jìu zhōngguóhùliánwǎngdefāzhǎnfābiǎolegèzìdekànfǎ 。
examples.en: Everyone expressed their views on the development of China's Internet.

examples.zh: 中国主席就中国最近的经济改革做了发言。
examples.pinyin: zhōngguózhǔxí jìu zhōngguózùijìndejīngjìgǎigézuòlefāyán 。
examples.en: The Chinese President made a statement on China's recent economic reforms.

examples.zh: 来自各国的教育学者们就什么是最好的教育方法进行了激烈的讨论。
examples.pinyin: láizìgèguódejiàoyùxuézhěmen jìu shíyāoshìzùihǎodejiàoyùfāngfǎjìnxínglejīlièdetǎolùn 。
examples.en: Educational scholars from all over the world have heated discussions on what is the best educational method.

examples.zh: 就中国的独生子女政策而言，专家各有各的看法。
examples.pinyin: jìu zhōngguó de dúshēngzǐnv̌ zhèngcè éryán，zhuānjiā gè yǒu gè de kànfǎ 。
examples.en: As far as China's one-child policy is concerned, experts have different opinions.

lessons.title: Opportune timing with "chen"
lessons.category: Indicating conditions, Indicating cause and effect

examples.zh: 趁年轻，多去玩玩吧。
examples.pinyin: chèn niánqīng，duō qù wánwán ba 。
examples.en: While young, go play more.

examples.zh: 趁天气好，我要去野餐。
examples.pinyin: chèn tiānqì hǎo，wǒ yào qù yěcān 。
examples.en: While the weather is good, I'm going to have a picnic.

examples.zh: 趁老板不在，我们抽一会儿烟吧。
examples.pinyin: chèn lǎobǎn bù zài，wǒmen chōu yīhùi ér yān ba 。
examples.en: Let's smoke for a while while the boss is away.

examples.zh: 趁孩子睡着的时候，我洗了很多衣服。
examples.pinyin: chèn háizǐ shùizháo de shíhòu，wǒ xǐ le hěn duō yīfú 。
examples.en: While the child was asleep, I washed a lot of clothes.

lessons.title: Expressing "if it were not for" with "yaobushi"

examples.zh: 要不是她帮忙，我们不可能这么快找到这个地方。
examples.pinyin: yàobùshì tā bāngmáng，wǒmen bùkěnéng zhèyāo kuài zhǎodào zhè gè dìfāng 。
examples.en: Without her help, we could not find this place so quickly.

examples.zh: 要不是你说你想吃，我不会做这个菜的。
examples.pinyin: yàobùshì nǐ shuō nǐ xiǎng chī，wǒ bù hùi zuò zhè gè cài de 。
examples.en: If you said you wanted to eat, I wouldn't make this dish.

examples.zh: 要不是因为他是你朋友，我是不会帮他的。
examples.pinyin: yàobùshì yīnwèi tā shì nǐ péngyǒu，wǒ shì bù hùi bāng tā de 。
examples.en: If it were not for his friend, I would not help him.

examples.zh: 要不是你们迟到的话，我们早就到了。
examples.pinyin: yàobùshì nǐmen chídào dehuà，wǒmen zǎo jìu dào le 。
examples.en: If it were not for you to be late, we would have arrived long ago.

examples.zh: 我能这么快做完，多亏了你帮我。
examples.pinyin: wǒ néng zhèyāo kuài zuòwán ，duōyúle nǐ bāng wǒ 。
examples.en: I can finish it so quickly, thanks to you for helping me.

examples.zh: 我没迟到，多亏了你开车送我。
examples.pinyin: wǒ méi chídào ，duōyúle nǐ kāichē sòng wǒ 。
examples.en: I was not late, thanks to you driving me.

examples.zh: 多亏了你开车送我，我才没迟到。
examples.pinyin: duōyúle nǐ kāichē sòng wǒ ，wǒ cái méi chídào 。
examples.en: Thanks to you driving me, I was not late.

examples.zh: 多亏你的伞，我才没淋湿。
examples.pinyin: duōyú nǐ de sǎn ，wǒ cái méi línshī 。
examples.en: Thanks to your umbrella, I didn't get wet.

examples.zh: 他只是开个玩笑而已，不要当真。
examples.pinyin: tā zhǐ shì kāi gè wánxiào éryǐ，bù yào dāng zhēn 。
examples.en: He is just kidding, don't take it seriously.

examples.zh: 你才喝了一瓶啤酒而已，怎么会喝醉了呢？
examples.pinyin: nǐ cái hē le yī píng píjǐu éryǐ，zěnyāo hùi hē zùi le ní ？
examples.en: You only drank a bottle of beer, how come you are drunk?

examples.zh: 这次会议没有达成具体的方案，仅仅是在这个问题上达成了共识而已。
examples.pinyin: zhè cì hùiyì méiyǒu dáchéng jùtǐ de fāngàn，jǐnjǐn shì zài zhè gè wèntí shàng dáchéng le gòngshì éryǐ 。
examples.en: No specific plan was reached at this meeting, only a consensus was reached on this issue.

examples.zh: 这辆车没什么特别，它就是辆普通的汽车而已。
examples.pinyin: zhè liàng chē méi shíyāo tèbié，tā jìu shì liàng pǔtōng de qìchē éryǐ 。
examples.en: This car is nothing special, it is just an ordinary car.

examples.zh: 离什么婚！你们结婚才三个月。
examples.pinyin: lí shíyāo hūn ！nǐmen jiéhūncái sān gè yuè 。
examples.en: What a divorce! You have only been married for three months.

examples.zh: 道什么歉啊，又不是你的错。
examples.pinyin: dào shíyāo qiàn a ，yòu bù shì nǐ de cuò 。
examples.en: What an apology is not your fault.

examples.zh: 开什么玩笑啊，你撞了我，我还要跟你说“对不起”？
examples.pinyin: kāi shíyāo wánxiào a ，nǐ zhuàng le wǒ ，wǒ huányào gēn nǐ shuō “dùibùqǐ” ？
examples.en: What a joke, you hit me, and I have to say "sorry" to you?

examples.zh: 没有钱看什么电影。
examples.pinyin: méiyǒu qián kàn shíyāo diànyǐng 。
examples.en: No money to watch any movies.

lessons.title: Comparing specifically with "xiang"
lessons.pattern: Noun 1 + 像 + Noun 2 + 一样 + Adj. / Verb

examples.zh: 她有时候像小孩一样天真。
examples.pinyin: tā yǒushíhòu xiàng xiǎohái yīyáng tiānzhēn 。
examples.en: She is sometimes naive like a child.

examples.zh: 这个老外的汉语像中国人一样地道。
examples.pinyin: zhègè lǎowài de hànyǔ xiàng zhōngguórényīyáng dìdào 。
examples.en: The foreigner's Chinese is as authentic as the Chinese.

examples.zh: 他很生气，像疯子一样大叫起来。
examples.pinyin: tā hěn shēngqì ，xiàng fēngzǐ yīyáng dà jiào qǐlái 。
examples.en: He was angry and yelled like a lunatic.

examples.zh: 你怎么像我妈一样啰嗦！
examples.pinyin: nǐ zěnyāo xiàng wǒ mā yīyáng luōsuō ！
examples.en: Why are you as verbose as my mother!

examples.zh: 比起上海，我老家的物价便宜多了。
examples.pinyin: bǐqǐshànghǎi ，wǒ lǎojiā de wùjià biànyí duō le 。
examples.en: Compared to Shanghai, the price in my hometown is much cheaper.

examples.zh: 本科生比起博士生来，学位要低很多。
examples.pinyin: běnkēshēng bǐqǐ bóshìshēng lái，xuéwèi yào dī hěn duō 。
examples.en: Undergraduates have much lower degrees than doctoral students.

examples.zh: 相比几十年前，中国的农村发生了很大变化。
examples.pinyin: xiāngbǐ jīshí nián qián ，zhōngguó de nóngcūn fāshēng le hěn dà biànhuà 。
examples.en: Compared with decades ago, China's rural areas have undergone great changes.

examples.zh: 与几十年前相比，中国的农村发生了很大变化。
examples.pinyin: yǔ jīshí nián qián xiāngbǐ，zhōngguó de nóngcūn fāshēng le hěn dà biànhuà 。
examples.en: Compared with a few decades ago, great changes have taken place in China's rural areas.

examples.zh: 我哥的成绩不如我。
examples.pinyin: wǒ gē de chéngjī bùrú wǒ 。
examples.en: My brother's grades are not as good as mine.

examples.zh: 看电影不如看原著。
examples.pinyin: kàn diànyǐng bùrú kàn yuánzhù 。
examples.en: Watching the movie is worse than watching the original.

examples.zh: 他总是觉得自己不如别人。
examples.pinyin: tā zǒngshì juédé zìjǐ bùrú biérén 。
examples.en: He always feels inferior to others.

examples.zh: 这件裙子不如那件好看。
examples.pinyin: zhè jiàn qúnzǐ bùrú nà jiàn hǎokàn 。
examples.en: This skirt is not as good-looking as that one.

examples.zh: 现代化
examples.pinyin: xiàndàihuà
examples.en: modernization

examples.zh: 中国化
examples.pinyin: zhōngguóhuà
examples.en: Chinese Characteristics

examples.zh: 美国化
examples.pinyin: měiguóhuà
examples.en: Americanization

examples.zh: KFC的中国本土化经营做得非常成功。
examples.pinyin: KFC de zhōngguó běntǔhuà jīngyíng zuò dé fēicháng chénggōng 。
examples.en: KFC's localized operation in China has been very successful.

examples.zh: 她算天才。
examples.pinyin: tā suàn tiāncái 。
examples.en: She is a genius.

examples.zh: 这算秘密吗？
examples.pinyin: zhè suàn mìmì ma ？
examples.en: Is this a secret?

examples.zh: 她算不算你女朋友？
examples.pinyin: tā suàn bù suàn nǐ nv̌péngyǒu ？
examples.en: Is she your girlfriend?

examples.zh: 美国的中国菜算中国菜吗？
examples.pinyin: měiguó de zhōngguó cài suàn zhōngguó cài ma ？
examples.en: Is American Chinese food considered Chinese?

examples.zh: 难怪他，他还是个孩子呢，什么都不懂。
examples.pinyin: nánguài tā，tā huán shì gè háizǐ ní，shíyāo dū bù dǒng 。
examples.en: No wonder he, he is a child, knows nothing.

examples.zh: 这也难怪你，第一次到这个地方还不了解这里的风俗。
examples.pinyin: zhè yě nánguàinǐ，dì yī cì dào zhè gè dìfāng huán bù lejiě zhèlǐ de fēngsú 。
examples.en: It ’s no wonder that you did n’t understand the customs here for the first time.

examples.zh: 这也难怪，他刚来嘛，算了算了。
examples.pinyin: zhè yě nánguài，tāgāngláima，suànlesuànle 。
examples.en: It's no wonder, he just came, forget it.

lessons.title: Expressing future with "jiang"
lessons.pattern: Subj. + 将 / 将要 / 将会 + [Verb Phrase]
lessons.category: Referring to the future, Sequencing events in time

examples.zh: 这次世界杯将在莫斯科举行。
examples.pinyin: zhè cì shìjièbēi jiāng zài mòsīkē jǔxíng 。
examples.en: The World Cup will be held in Moscow.

examples.zh: 比赛结果将在月底公布。
examples.pinyin: bǐsài jiéguǒ jiāng zài yuèdǐ gōngbù 。
examples.en: The results of the competition will be announced at the end of the month.

examples.zh: 他将会成为一个成功的企业家。
examples.pinyin: tā jiāng hùi chéngwèi yī gè chénggōng de qǐyèjiā 。
examples.en: He will become a successful entrepreneur.

examples.zh: 如果政府不批准，我们将会举行抗议。
examples.pinyin: rúguǒ zhèngfǔ bù pīzhǔn ，wǒmen jiāng hùi jǔxíng kàngyì 。
examples.en: If the government does not approve, we will hold a protest.

lessons.title: The use of Taiwanese Mandarin "hui"
lessons.category: Referring to the future, Expressing possibility

examples.zh: 你会冷吗？
examples.pinyin: nǐ hùi lěng ma ？
examples.en: Will you be cold?

examples.zh: 这个会辣吗？
examples.pinyin: zhègè hùi là ma ？
examples.en: Will this be spicy?

examples.zh: 刚开始说外语时难免会有一些误会。
examples.pinyin: gāng kāishǐ shuō wàiyǔ shí nánmiǎn hùi yǒu yīxiē wùhùi 。
examples.en: There are some misunderstandings when I first speak a foreign language.

examples.zh: 年轻人难免会遇到挫折，关键是学习怎么样克服。
examples.pinyin: niánqīng rén nánmiǎn hùi yùdào cuòzhé，guānjiàn shì xuéxí zěnyāoyáng kèfú 。
examples.en: Young people will inevitably encounter setbacks, the key is to learn how to overcome them.

examples.zh: 第一次坐飞机出国难免会有点兴奋。
examples.pinyin: dì yī cì zuò fēijī chūguó nánmiǎn hùi yǒudiǎn xīngfèn 。
examples.en: It is inevitable that I will be a little excited to go abroad for the first time.

examples.zh: 现在是高峰期，地铁难免会拥挤。
examples.pinyin: xiànzài shì gāofēngqī，dìtiě nánmiǎn hùi yǒngjǐ 。
examples.en: This is the peak period and the subway will inevitably be crowded.

examples.zh: 我国提倡垃圾分类，以便回收再利用。
examples.pinyin: wǒguó tíchàng lājí fēnlèi，yǐbiàn húishōu zàilìyòng 。
examples.en: Our country promotes garbage classification for recycling.

examples.zh: 老李买了一辆折叠式的自行车，以便携带。
examples.pinyin: lǎolǐ mǎi le yī liàng zhédié shì de zìxíngchē，yǐbiàn xiédài 。
examples.en: Lao Li bought a folding bicycle for easy carrying.

examples.zh: 老师减慢了语速，以便学生能听懂。
examples.pinyin: lǎoshī jiǎnmàn le yǔsù，yǐbiàn xuéshēng néng tīngdǒng 。
examples.en: The teacher slowed down his speech so that the students could understand.

examples.zh: 张老师的课很受学生的欢迎。
examples.pinyin: zhānglǎoshīdekè hěn shòu xuéshēng de huānyíng 。
examples.en: Teacher Zhang's class is very popular with students.

examples.zh: 一个人不一定要变得很有钱或者很成功才会受人尊重。
examples.pinyin: yīgèrén bùyīdìng yào biàndé hěn yǒuqián huòzhě hěn chénggōng cái hùi shòu rén zūnzhòng 。
examples.en: A person does not have to be rich or successful to be respected.

examples.zh: 中国政府受老百姓的批评。
examples.pinyin: zhōngguó zhèngfǔ shòulǎobǎixìngdepīpíng 。
examples.en: The Chinese government has been criticized by the common people.

examples.zh: 受冷空气的影响，今天上海特别冷。
examples.pinyin: shòu lěng kōngqì de yǐngxiǎng，jīntiān shànghǎi tèbié lěng 。
examples.en: Affected by the cold air, Shanghai is particularly cold today.

examples.zh: 下过雨的早晨格外舒服.
examples.pinyin: xiàguòyǔdezǎochéngéwàishūfú.
examples.en: The rainy morning is particularly comfortable.

examples.zh: 今天格外忙,都来不及吃午饭.
examples.pinyin: jīntiāngéwàimáng, dūláibùjíchīwǔfàn.
examples.en: It's so busy today that it's too late to have lunch.

examples.zh: 昨天登山累了,晚上睡得格外香甜.
examples.pinyin: zuótiāndēngshānlèile, wǎnshàngshùidégéwàixiāngtián.
examples.en: I was tired from climbing yesterday and I slept very sweetly at night.

examples.zh: 我帮了她，她反而生气了。
examples.pinyin: wǒ bāng le tā ， tā fǎnér shēngqì le 。
examples.en: I helped her, but she was angry.

examples.zh: 他没有放弃，反而更努力了！
examples.pinyin: tā méiyǒu fàngqì ，fǎnér gèng nǔlì le ！
examples.en: He did not give up, but worked harder!

examples.zh: 改革反而让老百姓更不满意了。
examples.pinyin: gǎigé fǎnér ràng lǎobǎixìng gèng bù mǎnyì le 。
examples.en: Instead, the reform made the people more dissatisfied.

examples.zh: 吃了这个药，病反而更严重了。
examples.pinyin: chī le zhègè yào ，bìng fǎnér gèng yánzhòng le 。
examples.en: After taking this medicine, the disease became worse.

lessons.title: Stating the effect before the cause
lessons.pattern: 之所以 ⋯⋯ ，是 + 因为 / 为了 / 想 ⋯⋯
lessons.category: Sequencing events in time, Indicating cause and effect

examples.zh: 她之所以问这么多是因为她关心你们。
examples.pinyin: tā zhī suǒyǐ wèn zhèyāo duō shì yīnwèi tā guānxīn nǐmen 。
examples.en: The reason why she asks so much is because she cares about you.

examples.zh: 我之所以没告诉你是不想让你担心。
examples.pinyin: wǒ zhī suǒyǐ méi gàosù nǐ shì bù xiǎng ràng nǐ dànxīn 。
examples.en: The reason why I didn't tell you is that I don't want to worry you.

examples.zh: 他之所以放弃了那份工作是因为他找到了更好的机会。
examples.pinyin: tā zhī suǒyǐ fàngqì le nàfèn gōngzuò shì yīnwèi tā zhǎodào le gènghǎo de jīhùi 。
examples.en: He gave up that job because he found a better opportunity.

examples.zh: 我们之所以保密是想给她一个惊喜。
examples.pinyin: wǒmen zhī suǒyǐ bǎomì shì xiǎng gěi tā yī gè liángxǐ 。
examples.en: The reason we keep it secret is to surprise her.

lessons.title: Using "because" with "er" to indicate effect
lessons.pattern: Subj. + 因(为) + Cause + 而 + Result
lessons.category: Indicating conditions, Sequencing events in time, Indicating cause and effect

examples.zh: 我因为生病而请假。
examples.pinyin: wǒ yīnwèi shēngbìng ér qǐngjiǎ 。
examples.en: I took leave because I was sick.

examples.zh: 欧洲的经济因为债务危机而陷入衰退。
examples.pinyin: ōuzhōu de jīngjì yīnwèi zhàiwù wēijī ér xiànrù shuāitùi 。
examples.en: The European economy has fallen into recession because of the debt crisis.

examples.zh: 首相因为受贿丑闻而下了台。
examples.pinyin: shǒuxiāng yīnwèi shòuhùi chǒuwén ér xià le tái 。
examples.en: The prime minister stepped down because of the bribery scandal.

examples.zh: 伦敦地铁因罢工而处于瘫痪状态。
examples.pinyin: lúndūn dìtiě yīn bàgōng ér chùyú tānhuàn zhuàngtài 。
examples.en: The London Underground was paralyzed by the strike.

lessons.title: Advanced degree complements
lessons.pattern: Adj. + 得 + 很 / 不得了 / 要命 / 不行

examples.zh: 这个孩子自私得很。
examples.pinyin: zhègè háizǐ zìsī déhěn 。
examples.en: The child is very selfish.

examples.zh: 我老婆的工作轻松得很。
examples.pinyin: wǒ lǎopó de gōngzuò qīngsōng déhěn 。
examples.en: My wife's work is very easy.

examples.zh: 我爸爸固执得不得了。
examples.pinyin: wǒ bàbà gùzhí dé bùdéle 。
examples.en: My dad is stubborn.

examples.zh: 赢了比赛以后，他骄傲得不得了。
examples.pinyin: yíng le bǐsài yǐhòu ，tā jiāoào dé bùdéle 。
examples.en: After winning the game, he was extremely proud.

lessons.title: Advanced potential complements
lessons.pattern: Verb + 得 / 不 + 了 :: / :: Verb + 得 / 不 + 下 :: / :: Verb + 得 / 不 + 起 + Obj. :: / :: Verb + 得 / 不 + 动 :: / :: Verb + 得 / 不 + 着

examples.zh: 他那么老，走得了那么多路吗？
examples.pinyin: tā nàyāo lǎo ，zǒu dé le nàyāo duō lù ma ？
examples.en: He is so old, has he walked so many ways?

examples.zh: 今晚我有事，去不了。
examples.pinyin: jīnwǎn wǒ yǒu shì ，qù bù le 。
examples.en: I have something tonight and I can't go.

examples.zh: 这件衣服太小了，我穿不了。
examples.pinyin: zhè jiàn yīfú tài xiǎo le ，wǒ chuān bù le 。
examples.en: This dress is too small for me to wear.

examples.zh: 这件事情只有你帮得了我。
examples.pinyin: zhè jiàn shìqíng zhǐ yǒu nǐ bāng dé le wǒ 。
examples.en: Only you can help me with this matter.

examples.zh: 抓住那个小偷！
examples.pinyin: zhuāzhù nàgè xiǎotōu ！
examples.en: Grab the thief!

examples.zh: 不好意思，你挡住了我的路。
examples.pinyin: bù hǎoyìsī ，nǐ dǎngzhù le wǒ de lù 。
examples.en: Sorry, you blocked my way.

examples.zh: 一定要记住我的话。
examples.pinyin: yīdìng yào jìzhù wǒ de huà 。
examples.en: Be sure to remember my words.

examples.zh: 你必须抓住机会。
examples.pinyin: nǐ bìxū zhuāzhù jīhùi 。
examples.en: You must seize the opportunity.

examples.zh: 大家都累坏了。
examples.pinyin: dàjiā dū lèi huàile 。
examples.en: Everyone is exhausted.

examples.zh: 我早饭和中饭都没吃，饿坏了。
examples.pinyin: wǒ zǎofàn hé zhōngfàn dū méi chī ，è huàile 。
examples.en: I didn't eat breakfast and lunch and was hungry.

examples.zh: 发现爸爸又去赌钱了，妈妈气坏了。
examples.pinyin: fāxiàn bàbà yòu qù dǔqián le ，māmā qì huàile 。
examples.en: When my dad went to gamble again, my mother was furious.

examples.zh: 孩子不见了，妈妈急坏了。
examples.pinyin: háizǐ bùjiàn le ，māmā jí huàile 。
examples.en: The child was gone and my mother was in a hurry.

examples.zh: 我还没有做。
examples.pinyin: wǒ huán méiyǒu zuò 。
examples.en: I haven't done it yet.

examples.zh: 我下个星期可以做。
examples.pinyin: wǒ xià gè xīngqī kěyǐ zuò 。
examples.en: I can do it next week.

examples.zh: 我相信你一定能做到。
examples.pinyin: wǒ xiāngxìn nǐ yīdìng néng zuòdào 。
examples.en: I believe you can do it.

examples.zh: 我还没有买。
examples.pinyin: wǒ huán méiyǒu mǎi 。
examples.en: I haven't bought it yet.

lessons.title: Using "lai" and "qu" when "verbing around"
lessons.category: Describing actions, Expressing movement, Expressing duration

examples.zh: 学生们都很紧张，在考场外面走来走去。
examples.pinyin: xuéshēngmen dū hěn jǐnzhāng，zài kǎocháng wàimiàn zǒu lái zǒu qù 。
examples.en: The students were very nervous and walked outside the examination room.

examples.zh: 他说来说去还不承认自己错了。
examples.pinyin: tā shuō lái shuō qù huán bù chéngrèn zìjǐ cuò le 。
examples.en: He said that he didn't admit he was wrong.

examples.zh: 我想来想去都想不明白，他怎么能那样对我？
examples.pinyin: wǒ xiǎng lái xiǎng qù dū xiǎng bù míngbái，tā zěnyāo néng nàyáng dùi wǒ ？
examples.en: I can't figure it out, how can he treat me like that?

examples.zh: 他翻来翻去，终于找到了那双破袜子。
examples.pinyin: tā fān lái fān qù， zhōngyú zhǎodào le nà shuāng pò wàzǐ 。
examples.en: He rummaged around and finally found the pair of broken socks.

examples.zh: 宝宝刚睡着。
examples.pinyin: bǎobǎo gāng shùi zháo 。
examples.en: The baby just fell asleep.

examples.zh: 你的手机找着了吗？
examples.pinyin: nǐ de shǒujī zhǎo zháo le ma ？
examples.en: Did you find your mobile phone?

examples.zh: 超市关门了，你要的东西我没买着。
examples.pinyin: chāoshì guānmén le ，nǐ yào de dōngxī wǒ méi mǎi zháo 。
examples.en: The supermarket is closed. I didn't buy what you wanted.

examples.zh: 晚上我睡不着的时候就看书。
examples.pinyin: wǎnshàng wǒ shùi bù zháo de shíhòu jìu kànshū 。
examples.en: I read when I can't sleep at night.

lessons.title: Expressing "once...then..." with "yidan...jiu..."
lessons.category: Indicating conditions, Indicating cause and effect

examples.zh: 一旦我找好的工作，我就会安心。
examples.pinyin: yīdàn wǒ zhǎo hǎo de gōngzuò，wǒ jìu hùi ānxīn 。
examples.en: Once I find a good job, I will feel at ease.

examples.zh: 这张桌子不稳定，一旦发生什么小小的振动，就会倒塌。
examples.pinyin: zhè zhāng zhuōzǐ bù wěndìng，yīdàn fāshēng shíyāo xiǎo xiǎo de zhèndòng，jìu hùi dǎotā 。
examples.en: This table is unstable and will collapse if there is any small vibration.

examples.zh: 学习计算机科学的学生很自信，他们一旦毕业，就会找到很好的工作。
examples.pinyin: xuéxí jìsuànjī kēxué de xuéshēng hěn zìxìn，tāmen yīdàn bìyè，jìu hùi zhǎodào hěn hǎo de gōngzuò 。
examples.en: Students studying computer science are very confident that once they graduate, they will find a good job.

examples.zh: 千万不要在经济泡沫中炒股，一旦市场崩溃，你会很后悔的！
examples.pinyin: qiānwàn bù yào zài jīngjì pàomò zhōng chǎogǔ，yīdàn shìcháng bēngkùi，nǐ hùi hěn hòuhǔi de！
examples.en: Don't speculate in the economic bubble, you will regret it once the market collapses!

lessons.title: Expressing "even if…" with "jiushi"
lessons.pattern: 就是 + Hypothetical Statement + 也 + Action

examples.zh: 就是这台电脑价格上万，我也会买。
examples.pinyin: jìushì zhè tái diànnǎo jiàgé shàngwàn，wǒ yě hùi mǎi 。
examples.en: Even if the price of this computer is tens of thousands, I will buy it.

examples.zh: 就是降温了，我也要穿热裤，时尚嘛!
examples.pinyin: jìushì jiàngwēn le，wǒ yě yào chuān rèkù，shíshàng ma!
examples.en: Just to cool down, I also want to wear hot pants, fashion!

examples.zh: 就是他变成一个穷光蛋，我也愿意跟他在一起。
examples.pinyin: jìushì tā biànchéng yīgè qióngguāngdàn，wǒ yě yuànyì gēn tā zài yīqǐ 。
examples.en: Even if he becomes a poor man, I am willing to be with him.

examples.zh: 现在虽然是高峰期，但我也要出去。
examples.pinyin: xiànzài sūirán shì gāofēngqī，dàn wǒ yě yào chūqù 。
examples.en: Although it is the peak period now, I have to go out.

examples.zh: 就算你不想听，我也要说。
examples.pinyin: jìusuàn nǐ bùxiǎng tīng ，wǒ yě yào shuō 。
examples.en: Even if you do n’t want to listen, I have to say.

examples.zh: 就算你说的都是真的，我们也没办法证明。
examples.pinyin: jìusuàn nǐ shuō de dū shì zhēnde ，wǒmen yě méi bànfǎ zhèngmíng 。
examples.en: Even if what you said is true, we have no way to prove it.

examples.zh: 就算会失败，我也不后悔。
examples.pinyin: jìusuàn hùi shībài ，wǒ yě bù hòuhǔi 。
examples.en: Even if it fails, I do not regret it.

examples.zh: 就算他说他请客，我也要买单。
examples.pinyin: jìusuàn tā shuō tā qǐngkè ，wǒ yě yào mǎidān 。
examples.en: Even if he says he is going to treat guests, I will pay.

examples.zh: 哪怕他不说，我也会知道。
examples.pinyin: nǎpà tā bù shuō ，wǒ yě hùi zhīdào 。
examples.en: Even if he does n’t say it, I will know.

examples.zh: 哪怕你什么礼物都没买，她也会很开心的。
examples.pinyin: nǎpà nǐ shíyāo lǐwù dū méi mǎi ，tā yě hùi hěn kāixīn de 。
examples.en: Even if you didn't buy any gifts, she would be very happy.

examples.zh: 哪怕他爸爸是总统，我也不要嫁给他！
examples.pinyin: nǎpà tā bàbà shì zǒngtǒng ，wǒ yě bù yào jià gěi tā ！
examples.en: Even if his father is the president, I don't want to marry him!

examples.zh: 哪怕你们会不高兴，我也要把话说清楚。
examples.pinyin: nǎpà nǐmen hùi bù gāoxīng ，wǒ yě yào bǎ huà shuō qīngchǔ 。
examples.en: Even if you will be unhappy, I have to make it clear.

lessons.title: Expressing "if… then…" with "jiaru"
lessons.category: Indicating conditions, Indicating cause and effect, Expressing possibility

examples.zh: 假如你的成绩再好一点儿，你就能申请北大了。
examples.pinyin: jiǎrú nǐ de chéngjī zài hǎo yīdiǎnér，nǐ jìu néng shēnqǐng běidà le 。
examples.en: If your grades are better, you can apply for Peking University.

examples.zh: 假如我是你，我就戒烟。
examples.pinyin: jiǎrú wǒ shì nǐ，wǒ jìu jièyān 。
examples.en: If I were you, I would quit smoking.

examples.zh: 假如你的女朋友不爱你，你们就分手吧。
examples.pinyin: jiǎrú nǐ de nv̌péngyǒu bù ài nǐ，nǐmen jìu fēnshǒu ba 。
examples.en: If your girlfriend doesn't love you, you can break up.

lessons.title: Expressing "if… then…" with "jiashi"
lessons.category: Indicating conditions, Indicating cause and effect, Expressing possibility

examples.zh: 假使明天下雨，我就不去上班了。
examples.pinyin: jiǎshǐ míngtiān xiàyǔ，wǒ jìu bù qù shàngbān le 。
examples.en: If it rains tomorrow, I won't go to work.

examples.zh: 假使你同意，我们立马签合同。
examples.pinyin: jiǎshǐ nǐ tóngyì，wǒmen lìmǎ qiān hétóng 。
examples.en: If you agree, we will immediately sign the contract.

examples.zh: 假使我们能找到更多的赞助，我们就可以帮助更多的孩子。
examples.pinyin: jiǎshǐ wǒmen néng zhǎodào gèng duō de zànzhù，wǒmen jìu kěyǐ bāngzhù gèngduō de háizǐ 。
examples.en: If we can find more sponsorship, we can help more children.

examples.zh: 万一我父母不同意呢？
examples.pinyin: wànyī wǒ fùmǔ bù tóngyì ní ？
examples.en: What if my parents disagree?

examples.zh: 万一被发现了怎么办？
examples.pinyin: wànyī bèi fāxiàn le zěnyāobàn ？
examples.en: What if I was found?

examples.zh: 带着伞吧，万一下雨呢？
examples.pinyin: dài zháo sǎn ba ，wànyī xiàyǔ ní ？
examples.en: Bring an umbrella, what if it rains?

examples.zh: 你先打电话问问。
examples.pinyin: nǐ xiān dǎ diànhuà wènwèn 。
examples.en: You call and ask first.

examples.zh: 北京的话，秋天去最好。
examples.pinyin: běijīng dehuà，qīutiān qù zùihǎo 。
examples.en: In Beijing, it is best to go in autumn.

examples.zh: 晚上的话，当然方便啦。
examples.pinyin: wǎnshàng dehuà，dāngrán fāngbiàn la 。
examples.en: At night, of course it is convenient.

examples.zh: 这个问题的话，我不太方便说。
examples.pinyin: zhègè wèntí dehuà，wǒ bù tài fāngbiàn shuō 。
examples.en: For this question, I am not very convenient to say.

examples.zh: 我肯定能去。
examples.pinyin: wǒ kěndìng néng qù 。
examples.en: I can definitely go.

lessons.title: Advanced uses of "ba"
lessons.pattern: Subj. + 把 + Obj. + 给 + Verb Phrase

examples.zh: 我把这事儿给忘了。
examples.pinyin: wǒ bǎ zhè shìér gěi wàng le 。
examples.en: I forgot about it.

examples.zh: 周末我把脏衣服给洗了。
examples.pinyin: zhōumò wǒ bǎ zāng yīfú gěi xǐ le 。
examples.en: I washed the dirty clothes on the weekend.

examples.zh: 你能把这些都给记住吗？
examples.pinyin: nǐ néng bǎ zhèxiē dū gěi jìzhù ma ？
examples.en: Can you remember all this?

examples.zh: 他把我的手机给摔坏了。
examples.pinyin: tā bǎ wǒde shǒujī gěi shuāihuài le 。
examples.en: He broke my mobile phone.

examples.zh: 你不比别人笨。
examples.pinyin: nǐ bù bǐ biérén bèn 。
examples.en: You are not dumb than others.

examples.zh: 他太太的工资不比他低。
examples.pinyin: tā tàitài de gōngzī bù bǐ tā dī 。
examples.en: His wife's salary is not lower than him.

examples.zh: 上海不比纽约便宜。
examples.pinyin: shànghǎibù bǐ nǐuyuē biànyí 。
examples.en: Shanghai is not cheaper than New York.

examples.zh: 有人觉得养宠物不比养小孩容易。
examples.pinyin: yǒurén juédé yǎngchǒngwù bù bǐ yǎng xiǎohái róngyì 。
examples.en: Some people think that keeping pets is not easier than raising children.

lessons.title: Conditions with "yao" and "jiu"
lessons.category: Giving commands, Indicating conditions, Expressing attitude

examples.zh: 要走就走，我们不需要你。
examples.pinyin: yào zǒu jìu zǒu ，wǒmen bù xūyào nǐ 。
examples.en: To leave, we don't need you.

examples.zh: 要买就买，我们快关门了。
examples.pinyin: yào mǎi jìu mǎi ，wǒmen kuài guānmén le 。
examples.en: Buy if you want, we are closing.

examples.zh: 要说就说，别吞吞吐吐。
examples.pinyin: yào shuō jìu shuō ，bié tūntūntǔtǔ 。
examples.en: Talk about it, don't talk about it.

examples.zh: 要去就去，不用等我们。
examples.pinyin: yào qù jìu qù ，bùyòng děng wǒmen 。
examples.en: If you want to go, go without waiting for us.

lessons.title: Expressing "in the name of" with "yi... de mingyi"

examples.zh: 不要以我的名义给公司写信,公司会找我麻烦的.
examples.pinyin: bùyàoyǐwǒdemíngyìgěigōngsīxiěxìn, gōngsīhùizhǎowǒmáfánde.
examples.en: Don't write to the company in my name, the company will trouble me.

examples.zh: 这个人是个诈骗犯,所以以政府的名义起诉了他.
examples.pinyin: zhègèrénshìgèzhàpiànfàn, suǒyǐyǐzhèngfǔdemíngyìqǐsùletā.
examples.en: This man is a fraudster, so he was prosecuted in the name of the government.

examples.zh: 以保护生命的名义去屠杀其他种族的人,并不是道德的.
examples.pinyin: yǐbǎohùshēngmìngdemíngyìqùtúshāqítāzhǒngzúderén, bìngbùshìdàodéde.
examples.en: It is not moral to kill people of other races in the name of protecting life.

examples.zh: 她睡前常常喝牛奶，好入睡。
examples.pinyin: tā shùiqián chángcháng hē níunǎi ，hǎo rùshùi 。
examples.en: She often drinks milk before going to bed to fall asleep.

examples.zh: 老师，请说慢点儿，我们好做笔记。
examples.pinyin: lǎoshī ，qǐng shuō màn diǎnér ，wǒmen hǎo zuò bǐjì 。
examples.en: Teacher, please speak slowly, we can take notes.

examples.zh: 请把车停到里面，好让别人走路。
examples.pinyin: qǐng bǎ chē tíng dào lǐmiàn ，hǎo ràng biérén zǒulù 。
examples.en: Please park your car inside so that others can walk.

lessons.title: Expressing simultaneous actions with "yimian"
lessons.pattern: 一面 + Verb + 一面 + Verb

examples.zh: 他喜欢一面吃东西，一面看电影。
examples.pinyin: tā xǐhuān yīmiàn chī dōngxī ， yīmiàn kàn diànyǐng 。
examples.en: He likes to eat while watching movies.

examples.zh: 我告诉你多少次了，别一面躺在床上一面吃零食！弄得床上都是碎屑!
examples.pinyin: wǒ gàosù nǐ duōshǎo cì le，bié yīmiàn tǎng zài chuángshàng yīmiàn chī língshí！nòngdé chuángshàng dū shì sùixiè!
examples.en: I tell you how many times, do n’t lie down on the bed while eating snacks! Make the bed full of debris!

examples.zh: 他们一家人一面赏月一面吃月饼。
examples.pinyin: tāmen yī jiārén yīmiàn shǎngyuè yīmiàn chī yuèbǐng 。
examples.en: Their family ate moon cakes while enjoying the moon.

examples.zh: 你会一面拍头一面揉肚子吗？
examples.pinyin: nǐ hùi yīmiàn pāitóu yīmiàn róu dùzǐ ma ？
examples.en: Would you rub your belly while patting your head?

examples.zh: 他整天不是打游戏就是睡觉。
examples.pinyin: tā zhěngtiān bù shì dǎyóuxì jìu shì shùijué 。
examples.en: He either plays games or sleeps all day.

examples.zh: 他们约会不是去咖啡馆就是去电影院。
examples.pinyin: tāmen yuēhùi bùshì qù kāfēiguǎn jìushì qù diànyǐngyuàn 。
examples.en: They date either to a cafe or to a movie theater.

examples.zh: 我买的衣服不是大就是小，都不能穿。
examples.pinyin: wǒ mǎi de yīfú bùshì dà jìushì xiǎo，dū bù néng chuān 。
examples.en: The clothes I buy are either big or small, and I can't wear them.

examples.zh: 她穿的衣服不是LV就是Gucci！
examples.pinyin: tā chuān de yīfú bùshì LV jìushì Gucci！
examples.en: The clothes she wears are either LV or Gucci!

examples.zh: 我宁可没有男朋友，也不要随便找一个男朋友。
examples.pinyin: wǒ níngkě méiyǒu nánpéngyǒu ，yěbù yào súibiàn zhǎo yī gè nánpéngyǒu 。
examples.en: I would rather not have a boyfriend than to find a boyfriend casually.

examples.zh: 我们宁可早到也不要迟到。
examples.pinyin: wǒmen níngkě zǎodào yěbù yào chídào 。
examples.en: We would rather be early than late.

examples.zh: 他宁可输，也不放弃。
examples.pinyin: tā níngkě shū ，yěbù fàngqì 。
examples.en: He would rather lose than give up.

examples.zh: 我宁可这个月少花一点，也不找父母要钱。
examples.pinyin: wǒ níngkě zhègèyuè shǎo huā yīdiǎn ，yěbù zhǎo fùmǔ yào qián 。
examples.en: I would rather spend less this month than ask my parents for money.

lessons.title: Occurring together with "shaobuliao"
lessons.pattern: Subj. + 少不了 + 要 + [Verb Phrase]
lessons.category: Referring to simultaneous events, Indicating conditions, Indicating cause and effect

examples.zh: 学中文少不了要学拼音和汉字。
examples.pinyin: xué zhōngwén shǎobùle yào xué pīnyīn hé hànzì 。
examples.en: To learn Chinese, you must learn Pinyin and Chinese characters.

examples.zh: 回家过年少不了要带点礼物给家人。
examples.pinyin: húijiā guònián shǎobùle yào dài diǎn lǐwù gěi jiārén 。
examples.en: You must bring some gifts to your family when you go home for Chinese New Year.

examples.zh: 过生日少不了要吃生日蛋糕。
examples.pinyin: guò shēngrì shǎobùle yào chī shēngrì dàngāo 。
examples.en: You must have a birthday cake for your birthday.

examples.zh: 大家都是邻居，以后少不了要麻烦您。
examples.pinyin: dàjiā dū shì línjū ，yǐhòu shǎobùle yào máfán nín 。
examples.en: Everyone is a neighbor, so I have to trouble you in the future.

examples.zh: 今天吃了炸鸡，等于白跑步了.
examples.pinyin: jīntiānchīlezhàjī，děngyúbáipǎobùle.
examples.en: Eating fried chicken today is equivalent to white running.

examples.zh: 你告诉小王就等于把秘密告诉了大家.
examples.pinyin: nǐgàosùxiǎowángjìuděngyúbǎmìmìgàosùledàjiā.
examples.en: You tell Xiao Wang that you are telling everyone the secret.

examples.zh: 浪费时间等于浪费生命.
examples.pinyin: làngfèishíjiānděngyúlàngfèishēngmìng.
examples.en: A waste of time is a waste of life.

examples.zh: 小张请假了，怪不得今天没有看到他。
examples.pinyin: xiǎozhāng qǐngjiǎ le，guàibùdé jīntiān méiyǒu kàndào tā 。
examples.en: Xiao Zhang asked for leave, no wonder he didn't see him today.

examples.zh: 天天迟到，怪不得他被炒鱿鱼了。
examples.pinyin: tiāntiān chídào ，guàibùdé tā bèi chǎoyóuyú le 。
examples.en: Late every day, no wonder he was fired.

examples.zh: 她是你妹妹？难怪你们长得这么像。
examples.pinyin: tā shì nǐ mèimèi ？nánguài nǐmen cháng dé zhèyāo xiàng 。
examples.en: Is she your sister? No wonder you look so similar.

examples.zh: 你手机没电了？怪不得我打不通。
examples.pinyin: nǐ shǒujī méidiàn le ？guàibùdé wǒ dǎ bù tōng 。
examples.en: Is your phone dead? No wonder I can't get through.

examples.zh: 只有一块蛋糕，或者你吃或者我吃。
examples.pinyin: zhǐ yǒu yī kuài dàngāo，huòzhě nǐ chī huòzhě wǒ chī 。
examples.en: There is only one piece of cake, either you eat or I eat.

examples.zh: 你或者学汉语，或者学法律，别的就别学了。
examples.pinyin: nǐ huòzhě xué hànyǔ ， huòzhě xué fǎlv̀，biédejìubiéxuéle 。
examples.en: You can learn Chinese or law, and do n’t learn anything else.

examples.zh: 咱们或者去爬山或者泡温泉。
examples.pinyin: zánmen huòzhě qù páshān huòzhě pàowēnquán 。
examples.en: Let's go mountain climbing or hot spring bathing.

lessons.title: Expressing "let alone" with "bie shuo"
lessons.pattern: 别说 + A ， 连 / 就是+ B + 也 / 都 + Verb

examples.zh: 别说一百，就是一块钱我也不给你。
examples.pinyin: biéshuō yībǎi， jìushì yī kuài qián wǒ yě bù gěi nǐ 。
examples.en: Not to mention one hundred, I won't give you a dollar.

examples.zh: 别说白酒，连啤酒的味道我都受不了。
examples.pinyin: biéshuō báijǐu，lián píjǐu de wèidào wǒ dū shòu bùle 。
examples.en: Not to mention liquor, I can't even bear the taste of beer.

examples.zh: 这么难的问题，别说你，就是老师也不知道答案。
examples.pinyin: zhèyāo nán de wèntí，biéshuō nǐ，jìushì lǎoshī yě bù zhīdào dáàn 。
examples.en: Such a difficult question, let alone you, even the teacher does not know the answer.

examples.zh: 别说做菜了，他连怎么煮方便面都不知道。
examples.pinyin: biéshuō zuò cài le，tā lián zěnyāo zhǔ fāngbiànmiàn dū bù zhīdào 。
examples.en: Not to mention cooking, he didn't even know how to cook instant noodles.

lessons.title: Expressing "let alone" with "geng buyong shuo"
lessons.pattern: 连 + A + 都 / 也 + Verb， 更不用说 + B + 了

examples.zh: 他都不会煮鸡蛋，更不用说做一大桌子的菜了。
examples.pinyin: tā dū bù hùi zhǔ jīdàn， gèngbùyòngshuō zuò yī dà zhuōzǐ de cài le 。
examples.en: He doesn't know how to cook eggs, let alone cook a large table.

examples.zh: 他连自己国家的国旗都不认识，更不用说其他国家的了。
examples.pinyin: tā lián zìjǐ guójiā de guóqí dū bù rènshì， gèngbùyòngshuō qítā guójiā de le 。
examples.en: He doesn't even know the national flag of his own country, let alone other countries.

examples.zh: 他从来没有出过远门，更不用说出国了。
examples.pinyin: tā cónglái méiyǒu chū guò yuǎnmén， gèngbùyòngshuō chūguó le 。
examples.en: He has never been far away, let alone abroad.

lessons.title: Expressing "let alone" with "hekuang"
lessons.pattern: Subj. + 连 ⋯⋯ 都 + Verb ，何况 ⋯⋯ 呢 ？

examples.zh: 这句话连孩子都懂，何况大人呢？
examples.pinyin: zhè jù huà lián háizǐ dū dǒng ，hékuàng dàrén ní ？
examples.en: Even children can understand this sentence, not to mention adults?

examples.zh: 他连那么难的题都会，何况一个这么简单的题呢？
examples.pinyin: tā lián nàyāo nán de tí dū hùi，hékuàng yīgè zhèyāo jiǎndān de tí ní ？
examples.en: He even has such difficult questions, not to mention such a simple question?

examples.zh: 我奶奶连高铁都没坐过，何况飞机呢？
examples.pinyin: wǒ nǎinǎi lián gāotiě dū méi zuò guò ，hékuàng fēijī ní ？
examples.en: My grandmother hasn't even sat on a high-speed train, let alone a plane?

examples.zh: 宝宝连走都不会，更何况跑呢？
examples.pinyin: bǎobǎo lián zǒu dū bù hùi，gèng hékuàng pǎo ní ？
examples.en: The baby can't even walk, let alone run?

lessons.title: Expressing "not only… but also" with "bujin"
lessons.pattern: Noun + 不仅 + A，而且 + B

examples.zh: 他不仅很帅，而且很聪明。
examples.pinyin: tā bùjǐn hěn shuài，érqiě hěn cōngmíng 。
examples.en: He is not only handsome, but also very smart.

examples.zh: 我们不仅完成了任务而且比规定日期提前了十天。
examples.pinyin: wǒmen bùjǐn wánchéng le rènwù érqiě bǐ gūidìng rìqī tíqián le shítiān 。
examples.en: Not only did we complete the task but we were ten days ahead of the set date.

examples.zh: 这道菜不仅好吃而且很有营养。
examples.pinyin: zhè dào càibùjǐn hǎochī érqiě hěn yǒu yíngyǎng 。
examples.en: This dish is not only delicious but also very nutritious.

lessons.title: Comparing "buduan" and "buting"
lessons.category: Expressing duration, Expressing time and date, Expressing attitude

examples.zh: 客户不断地改变主意，怎么办？
examples.pinyin: kèhù bùduàndì gǎibiàn zhǔyì，zěnyāo bàn ？
examples.en: What should customers do if they constantly change their minds?

examples.zh: 过去的两年里，我们不断地在努力，也不断地在进步。
examples.pinyin: guòqù de liǎng nián lǐ，wǒmen bùduàndì zài nǔlì，yě bùduàndì zài jìnbù 。
examples.en: In the past two years, we have been working hard and making progress.

examples.zh: 他们之间的矛盾一直不断，关系不断恶化。
examples.pinyin: tāmen zhījiān de máodùn yīzhí bùduàn，guānxì bùduàn èhuà 。
examples.en: The contradiction between them has been constant, and the relationship has continued to deteriorate.

examples.zh: 我今天很困，不停地打哈欠。
examples.pinyin: wǒjīntiānhěnkùn，bùtíngdìdǎhāqiàn 。
examples.en: I am very sleepy today and I keep yawning.

lessons.title: Comparing "changchang" and "jingchang"
lessons.category: Describing actions, Referring to habitual actions, Expressing frequency

examples.zh: 我常常收到垃圾短信。
examples.pinyin: wǒ chángcháng shōudào lājí duǎnxìn 。
examples.en: I often receive spam messages.

examples.zh: 你们经常加班吗？
examples.pinyin: nǐmen jīngcháng jiābān ma ？
examples.en: Do you often work overtime?

examples.zh: 他们常常吵架。
examples.pinyin: tāmen chángcháng chǎojià 。
examples.en: They often quarrel.

examples.zh: 他经常不吃早饭。
examples.pinyin: tā jīngcháng bù chī zǎofàn 。
examples.en: He often skips breakfast.

lessons.title: Comparing "turan" and "huran"
lessons.category: Describing actions, Expressing time and date, Referring to changes of situation, Expressing attitude

examples.zh: 睡觉的时候，我的电话突然响了。
examples.pinyin: shùijué de shíhòu，wǒ de diànhuàtūrán xiǎngle 。
examples.en: While sleeping, my phone rang suddenly.

examples.zh: 睡觉的时候，我的电话忽然响了。
examples.pinyin: shùijué de shíhòu，wǒ de diànhuàhūrán xiǎngle 。
examples.en: While sleeping, my phone rang suddenly.

examples.zh: 他说着说着突然不说了。
examples.pinyin: tā shuōzháoshuōzháotūrán bù shuō le 。
examples.en: He talked and suddenly stopped talking.

examples.zh: 他说着说着忽然不说了。
examples.pinyin: tā shuōzháoshuōzháohūrán bù shuō le 。
examples.en: He said and said suddenly.

lessons.title: Comparing "yizhi" and "yixiang"
lessons.category: Describing actions, Referring to habitual actions, Expressing frequency, Expressing time and date

examples.zh: 我会一直陪着你。
examples.pinyin: wǒ hùi yīzhí péizháo nǐ 。
examples.en: I will always stay with you.

examples.zh: 雨一直在下，我没办法出去。
examples.pinyin: yǔ yīzhí zàixià，wǒ méibànfǎ chūqù 。
examples.en: It's raining all the time, I can't get out.

examples.zh: 一直往前走，你会看到地铁站在你右边。
examples.pinyin: yīzhí wǎngqián zǒu，nǐ hùi kàndào dìtiězhàn zàinǐ yòubiān 。
examples.en: Go straight ahead and you will see the subway station on your right.

examples.zh: 我看书的时候，他一直在说话，很烦。
examples.pinyin: wǒkànshūdeshíhòu，tāyīzhí zàishuōhuà，hěnfán 。
examples.en: When I was reading, he was talking all the time, very annoying.

lessons.title: Comparing "zongsuan" and “zhongyu"
lessons.pattern: Subj. + 总算 / 终于 + Verb

examples.zh: 你总算来了！
examples.pinyin: nǐ zǒngsuànláile ！
examples.en: You are finally here!

examples.zh: 我终于懂了。
examples.pinyin: wǒ zhōngyú dǒng le 。
examples.en: I finally got it.

examples.zh: 雨总算停了。
examples.pinyin: yǔ zǒngsuàn tíng le 。
examples.en: The rain finally stopped.

examples.zh: 我终于找到你了！
examples.pinyin: wǒ zhōngyú zhǎodào nǐ le ！
